messages:
maria (infra): Heads-up — opened PR that updates Terraform for GPU networking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1024. It adjusts route_table associations for gpu-subnet and fixes ENI tagging for GPU nodes. No IAM changes but this touches prod route tables, so need 2 approvals before merge.

aj: Quick q — any IAM or policy changes in this? we should loop in security if so.

maria (infra): No IAM. Only aws_route_table_association and tag changes on aws_network_interface. Quick snippet from the plan: 
```
# module.gpu.aws_route_table_association.gpu_subnet will be created
+ resource "aws_route_table_association" "gpu_subnet" {
    subnet_id = "module.gpu.subnet_id"
    route_table_id = "aws_route_table.gpu_rt.id"
  }
```
No destroys or replacements in plan output. Intend to apply staging first.

ci-bot: CI: plan OK for PR #1024 — 3 additions, 1 change, 0 deletes. full plan: https://ci.redwood/plan/1024 :white_check_mark:

lee: I can review after standup (~40m). If someone else can LGTM earlier, awesome. Also — is there any expected customer impact?

maria (infra): Expected impact: low. Route association is for internal GPU subnet only, no public traffic changes. Will add a brief runbook to the PR with rollback steps (unlink association + reapply).

sasha: Please add the rollback commands and the exact staging verification steps in the PR description (e.g., how to validate ENI tags and that hosts join the GPU pool). Also note the apply window you want.

maria (infra): Will add runbook. Requesting apply window 2026-03-18 14:00 PST (staging at 13:00). Pinging @infra-oncall for awareness.

deploy-bot: Apply window created: 2026-03-18 14:00 PST — https://infra.redwood/schedules/1024. Please don't merge until window starts.

aj: Approved from my side, hold merge until the apply window starts. :thumbsup:

lee: Quick nit: can you change the comment in modules/gpu/network.tf to say "gpu-subnet route association (no customer impact)" for clarity? After that I'm good to approve.

maria (infra): Done — updated comment and pushed. Added runbook section: 
1) terraform workspace staging; terraform apply -var 'env=staging' -target=module.gpu.aws_route_table_association.gpu_subnet
2) verify ENI tags: aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters ...
3) smoke test: run kube node join check

ci-bot: Staging plan applied successfully in CI sandbox at 2026-03-18T13:05Z — no errors.

lee: LGTM after the comment tweak.

maria (infra): Merging and will run prod apply at the scheduled window. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Staging apply succeeded (run id: apply-789). Prod apply scheduled for 2026-03-18T14:05Z.

maria (infra): Prod apply completed, no failures observed. Closing PR and updating changelog.

aj: Thanks — appreciate the detailed runbook.

sasha: Nice work, thanks for the heads-up.
